RESOLUTION NO.
FOR A SMALL BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION SHUTTERED VENUE
OPERATORS GRANT TO RECOUP A PORTION OF REVENUE LOSSES
INCURRED AS A RESULT OF MANDATORY CORO NO VIRUS INDUCED
CIVIC CENTER CLOSURES."
WHEREAS, the Shuttered Venue Operators Grant Program, administered by the U.S.Small
Business Administration, was established by the Economic Aid to Hard-Hit Small Businesses,
Nonprofits, and Venues Act, and amended by the American Rescue Plan Act to provide emergency
assistance for eligible venues affected by C OVID-19; and
WHEREAS, the City of Cheyenne Civic Centeris eligible to receive funding in the amount
of $910,128.60whichis equal to45%ofits 2019gross earned revenue; and
WHEREAS, allowable fund uses include payroll costs, utility payments, worker protection
expenditures, administrative costs, insurance payments, advertising, production transportation, and
WHEREAS, the Cheyenne Civic Center meets Third Priority funding as a city entity that
suffered 25% or greater earned revenue loss between one quarter of 2019 and the corresponding
quarterof2020.
NOW, THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE
CITY OF CHEYENNE, WYOMING, that the G over ming Body authorizes the City of Cheyenne
$910,128.60 through the Small Business Administration Shuttered Venue Operators Grant program
for Fiscal Year 2021 to recoup a portion of revenue losses incurred as a result of mandatory
coronavirus induced Civic Center closures.
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the Mayor and City Clerk are authorized to execute all
documents, including a grant agreement, to secure funding under the U.s. Small Business
Administration to the extent that such documents are consistent with this Resolution.
PRESENTED, READ, AND ADOPTED this
dayof
,2021.
Patrick J. Collins, Mayor
